goal: Extend the eligibility-params editor to the 10 remaining contract tables (of 15), each as a country-selectable tab with live validation that blocks publish and a before->after diff dialog; remove the dead useSaveParams/validateParams/putParamsTable client code.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: All 10 remaining tables (Validation_Conditions, Validation_Combined_Conditions, Origen_NoConsiderar, Imputacion_ExCateg, IdDomicilio_Prueba, IdPainel, Variables, Parametros_Region, Criterios_Elegibilidad_Datas, Criterios_Elegibilidad_ExCateg) have an editor tab on the page, each rendered per the country selected from the 9-country selector.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Read ParametrosElegibilidadPage.tsx: 14 tabs registered (4 existing + 10 new); each new tab component receives the selected country. tsc -b passes.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Each new table has live client-side validation (types/duplicates/ranges/vocabulary as applicable) returning ValidationIssue[]; an error issue blocks publish (ReviewPublishDialog confirm-publish disabled when errors>0).
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: new cases in validation.test.ts assert each new validator flags its error class and passes clean rows. Publish-block reuses existing ParamsEditor/ReviewPublishDialog wiring.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The publish dialog shows the before->after diff per table for the new tables (diff prop wired via diffByIndex/diffByKey).
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: Each new tab passes a diff fn to ParamsEditor; e2e smoke asserts diff-table/diff-row visible for a new table.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: npm test + npm run lint + npx tsc -b + npm run build all pass.

Playwright @smoke covers at least 2 new tables: one rules table (Validation_Conditions) and one list table (an exclusion list). Tests assert validation blocks publish and the happy-path publish succeeds against the mock.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: MOCK_SERVER_PORT=8000 npm run test:e2e:fast (smoke project) green incl. the 2 new specs.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Dead code removed: useSaveParams (hooks.ts), putParamsTable + validateParams (api.ts), and the now-unused ValidationResult type are deleted; no remaining references.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: grep -rn 'useSaveParams|putParamsTable|validateParams' src returns nothing; tsc -b + lint clean.
